answers.description: A header-only C++ library implementing angle-based flattening algorithms for mesh parameterization.
answers.problem_statement: Developers lack a lightweight, easy-to-integrate C++ implementation of ABF++ and related mesh parameterization algorithms.
answers.target_users: C++ developers, computational geometry researchers, game developers
answers.key_goals: Zero-to-low dependency header-only integration; multiple algorithms (ABF, ABF++, LSCM); multi-chart flattening and packing; high numerical accuracy; production-efficient implementations.
answers.design_principles: Simplicity over features, Performance first, Developer experience focused
answers.distribution: CMake FetchContent / manual copy, Package managers (vcpkg, Conan, apt)
